metadata.name: th3-plug

paragraphs.text: DeepSeek Harness plugins (plugs): shell commands from the chat box with ! or /sh, plus a template an
d scripts for building more.
Small plugins ("plugs") you install into DeepSeek Harness straight from a folder.
No build step, no dependencies: plain JavaScript, one folder per plug.
## Plugs
| Plug | What it does |
|  **shell** | Run a command on your machine from the chat box with `!git status` or `/sh git status
`. The AI agent is never called. zsh completions and shell history pop up while you type; the output
comes back as a terminal block with the exit code and a Copy button. Package `@th3-plug/shell`. |
## Quick start
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Then ask the agent in DeepSeek Harness, using the absolute path of your clone:
> install bundle /absolute/path/to/th3-plug/plugs/shell
Reload the window (Cmd+R) and type `!pwd`.

The profile links the folder, so it keeps reading from your clone. After a
`git pull` that changes a

plug, remove and install it again, then reload the
window (details).
## Build a plug
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`npm run new` gives you a working plug: a `/myplug` command on the Host side,
a chat card for it on

the Web side, locale metadata, an icon and a test.
Replace the starter behaviour, keep the shape. do

cs/dsh-notes.md
lists the Harness APIs the existing plugs use and the traps worth knowing.
## Layout
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Conventions

- Folder `plugs/<name>` ↔ package `@th3-plug/<name>` ↔ Loader row id `th3-<name>`.
- Tunable values

live in the row's `config`, with defaults in `cordis.patch.yml`
and every key documented in the plug

README.
- Everything registers inside `apply` through `ctx.effect` / `ctx.on`, so
removing a plug r

brand colors are for icons, the repo and docs.
- Every plug ships a README, en + th locale metadata

, an icon and tests;
`npm run check` enforces the mechanical parts.
Working on this repo with a coding agent? It reads AGENTS.md.
## Brand

The badge is the plug from the th3r-dev split octagon: gold on the left, ink
on the right, a shell p

rompt on the plug's face. Logo files, plug-icon rules,
colors and type are in brand/BRAND.md; `npm r

un brand`
re-renders the PNGs from the SVG sources.
